title: Unsupported MCP top-level field
impact: Reported marketplace import rejects the plugin before any skill runs. The file has no actual server definitions.
fix: Remove the unused MCP file; regression-check unknown top-level MCP keys.

title: CI checked JSON syntax and versions, not portability or helper regressions
impact: Valid JSON could still contain unsupported import fields; original CI did not run the existing four smoke tests or official validation.
fix: Add metadata parity, portability, pytest, PostgreSQL execution and official Claude validation.

title: Developer-machine dependency path
impact: An absolute Windows file URI prevents installation on another machine.
fix: Use the shipped clustering requirements; split optional heavyweight packages.

title: Retired nonportable lifecycle helper
impact: Automatic setup/suggestions couple installation to host-specific shell/transcript assumptions; package downloads should be explicit.
fix: Remove lifecycle helpers; explicit seo-setup/seo-status and optional workflow suggestions replace them.

title: Incorrect DataForSEO request/response contract
impact: Keyword suggestion requests use the wrong seed field and result parser; task-level failures can masquerade as empty data.
fix: Use keywords array, direct result list, status checks and mocked regression tests; no paid calls made.

title: GET cache ignores account identity
impact: Two credential contexts can share a cache key; delimiter-based parameter encoding may collide.
fix: Hash canonical URL/parameters/normalised headers; atomic private writes, corrupt-cache recovery and TTL validation.

title: Stale credential cache and insufficient shape checks
impact: Edited credentials can remain stale; malformed provider structures fail unpredictably.
fix: Reload on access, validate shapes, respect native persistent data and an exclusive explicit override.

title: Unsupported Lighthouse invocation and implicit installation
impact: CLI options do not match the documented Lighthouse interface; automatic package execution obscures dependencies.
fix: Use mobile defaults/desktop preset, explicit installed binary, no automatic installation or sandbox disabling.

title: Cohort revenue multiplication and calendar errors
impact: Repeated user events are joined again and inflate revenue; epoch-based month division is not a calendar-month offset. Behaviour queries ignore the metric argument.
fix: One join to one first-event row per user; calendar offsets; metric-aware aggregation; identifier/literal validation and executable SQL tests.

title: Probability/sample-size boundary handling
impact: Invalid probabilities or impossible baseline+MDE combinations should not yield apparently meaningful sample sizes.
fix: Use stdlib inverse normal CDF and explicit finite/domain checks; retain approximation caveat.

title: Break-even rounding can understate required units
impact: Whole units rounded down can fail to cover fixed costs.
fix: Ceiling required units, keep exact continuous values, validate finite/non-negative inputs.

title: Net cashflows mislabelled as gross benefit-cost ratio
impact: Gross benefits/costs cannot be reconstructed from signed net flows; profitability index mishandles later negative flows.
fix: Correct PI, label net-flow ratio separately, return null gross BCR, clarify finite IRR search and validate inputs.

title: Even-length median and unsupported false-positive inference
impact: Upper-middle order statistic is not an even-sample median; breach counts alone cannot establish false-positive rates.
fix: Use statistics.median, finite values/bounds, describe observed alert workload.

title: Disabled configuration counted as configured protection
impact: A key set to false can pass recursive presence checks; malformed step shapes are not rejected consistently.
fix: Require enabled/nonempty values and structured step containers; describe this as a heuristic checklist.

title: robots.txt loses contiguous user-agent groups
impact: Rules following several User-agent lines should apply to every agent in the group; inline comments are not path text.
fix: Accumulate the group until rules start and strip comments; mocked parser tests.

title: Malformed JSON-LD silently omitted and coverage overstated
impact: A broken block can disappear from results; empty type arrays can crash, and presence coverage is not schema conformance.
fix: Report invalid blocks, handle bad type shapes and label coverage only; full conformance remains out of scope.

title: Token types lost; modern dimension objects emitted as invalid CSS
impact: Legacy type metadata is dropped and structured values can become JSON-like CSS instead of a dimension.
fix: Preserve type, support dimension/nested-shadow cases, reject unsupported composites instead of silent invalid output.

title: Invalid focus inputs silently ignored
impact: A missing/malformed exclusions file or wrong mode can change the intended clustering scope.
fix: Validate explicit focus files and mode choices; test the pure input function without pretending to exercise optional models.

title: Untrusted Markdown rendered as active HTML
impact: A report assembled from untrusted text can embed HTML/unsafe links in the offline dashboard. No deployed exploitation is claimed.
fix: Sanitise rendered fragments with Bleach; preserve tables/headings, strip active elements and unsafe protocols.

title: Startups bootstrap requires an absent external workspace system
impact: The marketplace is not self-contained; downstream paths, logging and updates assume external installation/hooks.
fix: Add local venture resolver/initialiser and a shared runtime contract; preserve legacy data without migration.

title: Open-question aggregation can ingest its own output
impact: Repeated runs can duplicate already aggregated questions and rely on nonexistent promotion hooks.
fix: Exclude aggregate/archive sources; deduplicate by source and question; preserve annotations and explicitly update state.

title: Retention/churn formula reversal
impact: Retention variable is applied as churn in survival/lifetime calculations, producing materially incorrect projections.
fix: Use survival r^n and lifetime 1/(1-r), correct example economics and add boundary-tested helper.

title: Impossible metric branch and premature scale language
impact: Mutually incompatible comparisons make a decision branch unreachable; qualitative interview evidence is not validated paid demand.
fix: Use disjoint ranges, direction-aware thresholds, sample/guardrail checks and cautious evidence decisions.

title: Delegation to a nonexistent Vercel skill
impact: The orchestrator depends on an unbundled workflow and can make its deployment plan incomplete.
fix: Provide an inline provider-neutral plan; retain optional provider recipes without a recursive handoff.

title: Unsupported stack default and stale version assumption
impact: The stack is recommended by default based on an unsubstantiated percentage and tooling availability rather than requirements.
fix: Remove forced provider stack and fixed framework version; compare simpler candidates and verify support/prices when needed.

title: Learning-card routing before test results exist
impact: An open test with no learning card is not a completed experiment with observations.
fix: Route concluded tests with evidence; distinguish heuristic counts and unvalidated market-fit gates.

title: Release guard accepts version downgrade
impact: Only equality is blocked; a lower version can pass as a change. Working-tree metadata can differ from the tested head.
fix: Require increasing release triplets; read catalogue from head ref; null-delimited changed paths; regression temp repositories.

title: Shell-based validator invocation
impact: CLI execution unnecessarily uses a shell, making paths and command handling brittle.
fix: Use spawnSync argument arrays, explicit missing-CLI failure and timeout.

title: Missing packaged references and source registry
impact: Four skill references and startups/SOURCES.md are absent or misnamed; connector/curriculum policies point outside the package.
fix: Bundle concise references, a transparent source registry and local confirmation policy; do not invent curriculum citations.

title: Host-specific metadata and execution assumptions
impact: 93 argument hints parse as YAML lists, and no native OpenAI manifests or UI metadata exist. Names of Claude tools do not make them available in ChatGPT.
fix: Quote scalar hints, generate native metadata, add runtime preflights and sequential/missing-capability fallbacks.

title: Skill counts and setup documentation drift
impact: Startups advertises 70 while shipping 69; root advertises 121 while shipping 120.
fix: Correct counts; marketing command-to-skill conversion makes the new total 122, including 30 marketing skills.
